citations.title: About WindBorne Models
excerpts: Built on proprietary balloon observations and continuous AI data assimilation, WindBorne delivers two forecast products: WeatherMesh, our family of AI weather models, and MetaMesh, our multi-model blend. WeatherMesh WeatherMesh transforms raw balloon observations into the world's fastest, most accurate weather forecasts. By combining cutting-edge AI models with a unique global network of weather balloons, we deliver insights at a speed and scale that traditional physics-based forecasting cannot match. ... [MetaMesh](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models-measurements/about-our-models/metamesh) is WindBorne's multi-model blend, fusing the world's leading AI and NWP forecasts with our proprietary WeatherMesh models.

citations.title: MetaMesh: Blended AI & NWP Weather Forecasts | WindBorne Systems
excerpts: **Proprietary observational data.** WeatherMesh is the only AI weather model initialized with WindBorne's [Global Sounding Balloon](https://windbornesystems.com/platform/observations) network — in-situ observations from altitudes and regions that radiosondes and satellites miss. That data flows through to MetaMesh. **AI-native data assimilation .** WeatherMesh runs on WindBorne's proprietary AI DA system, meaning it doesn't depend on ECMWF or NOAA for its initial conditions . MetaMesh blends a model that sees the atmosphere differently from every other input.

basis.reasoning: WindBorne’s documentation identifies WeatherMesh as its family of AI models and describes its data-assimilation system as proprietary. MetaMesh combines those models with public AI/NWP forecasts, without naming a third-party model vendor.

citations.title: WindBorne Systems API Reference
excerpts: The [Data API](https://windbornesystems.com/docs/api/data) provides access to observations collected by WindBorne’s constellation of Global Sounding Balloons. The standard measurement set recorded during flight consists of wind speed/direction, barometric pressure, ambient temperature, and relative humidity, along with GPS position and timestamp. The [Forecasts API](https://windbornesystems.com/docs/api/forecasts) provides access to WindBorne WeatherMesh, the world’s most accurate (i.e., lowest RMSE) global weather model. WeatherMesh currently predicts surface temperature, pressure, winds, precipitation, and radiation; and then geopotential, temperature, winds, and moisture at 28 pressure levels. Additionally, WindBorne provides a python wrapper around both APIs, including a [Command Line Interface](https://windbornesystems.com/docs/api/cli) and ways to access both
